gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM); High Grade Gliomas; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
Expansion in Newly Diagnosed High Grade Glioma patients at the Optimal Biological Dose.

candidate_evidence.quote: One is herpes simplex virus thymidine kinase (HSV-tk), which converts the pro-drug valaciclovir into an active drug that can kill tumour cells

candidate_flag.reason: Only drug-type agent is valaciclovir, the prodrug of the HSV-tk gene therapy TGX-007 (excluded type); coded candidate because the record states its conversion to a tumour-killing drug, but it could instead be seen as part of the gene therapy, which would fail S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients newly diagnosed with glioblastoma suitable for standard of care surgery and chemoradiotherapy or patients with recurrent glioblastoma suitable for further surgery may be eligible for the study.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: incidence of HSV-tk mRNA expression, or equivalent, in tissue

role_evidence.quote: TGX-007 is a gene therapy drug delivered by a harmless adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector which delivers two combined therapeutic payloads

agents.drug_class_hint: AAV-1 vector gene therapy carrying HSV-tk and IL-12, intratumoural
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: enable killing of proliferative cells and activation of an anti-tumour immune response

role_evidence.quote: Oral valaciclovir administered 3 times daily for 14 - 21 days
converts the pro-drug valaciclovir into an active drug that can kill tumour cells

agents.drug_class_hint: antiviral nucleoside prodrug used as the activating prodrug for HSV-tk suicide gene therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: converted by HSV-tk into an active drug that kills tumour cells

flag.reason: Candidate status depends on treating the prodrug as a separate antitumour agent rather than part of the gene therapy.

coder_notes: Gene therapy TGX-007 is an excluded intervention type. Valaciclovir is the only pharmacological antitumour-linked drug, so it is coded experimental_monotherapy and flagged. Standard of care surgery/chemoradiotherapy is mentioned as planned afterwards but is not a registered intervention. HSV-tk expression is a transgene readout, so target engagement is unclear. Arm 'Newly Diagnosed Expansion' admits high-grade glioma generally.
